title: No test proves the microphone and the voice clip stay private
what: Nothing checks that the microphone only starts after Speak, that the clip is removed from the phone after it is sent, or that the heard words stay in the box until the member taps Send. The Settings page version of voice has no test at all.
expected: A test that fails if recording starts before Speak, if the clip file is left behind, or if the words are sent without Send, on both the floating sheet and the Settings page.
fix_line: Add tests for the voice steps: no recording before Speak, clip deleted after sending, nothing sent before Send

title: Back on a screen with steps has no test
what: The back handling that takes a member from step 2 to step 1, asks before leaving with typed values, and closes only once after Done is never tested, neither in a unit test nor on a device.
expected: A test that presses back on step 2 and sees step 1 with the typed values kept, and one that sees the keep-or-leave question.
fix_line: Add a device test that presses back on a step screen with values typed

title: The help box's member messages are almost never checked word for word
what: Lines members read in Help and feedback, such as the thanks line, the could-not-send line, the write-something-first line, the glad-it-helped line, the we-reply-soon line, the empty list line and the voice too-short and microphone lines, are not checked by any test. The one device test that sends a question accepts any of three outcomes, so it passes even when no answer comes.
expected: Each of these lines checked once, and the send test requiring the answer or the thanks line.
fix_line: Add one words test for the help box and make the device send test require the answer or thanks

title: No test proves a member sees only their own help questions
what: Nothing checks that Your questions shows only the questions sent from this install, never another member's, that they are not shown to gym staff, that they are gone after an erase, or that replies survive a changed install id.
expected: A test that asks with one install's details and gets none of another install's questions, and one that erases and sees an empty list.
fix_line: Add a test that two installs never see each other's questions and that erase empties the list

title: No test checks who gets suggested weights locked
what: No test checks that suggested weights are shown or locked as the MettleUp Plus promise says, that a gym member on an active plan never sees them locked, or that workout history stays on the phone to work out a target. The Plus device test only checks older charts.
expected: A test for each case: free member, Plus member, gym member on a plan.
fix_line: Add a test of the suggested-weights lock for free, Plus and gym members

title: The coach's notes to the member are never checked
what: The coach engine tests check the numbers (start at the empty bar, add 2.5 kg, cut 10 %), but none of the notes the member reads with them, such as the push-for-one-more line, the move-up line, the first-time lines or the plateau line. The same day's target staying put, and a first-time dumbbell start, are not checked either.
expected: Each note checked once next to its number.
fix_line: Check each coach note's words in the engine test
